biography.en: Xu Yinchuan is a Chinese xiangqi grandmaster from Huilai, Guangdong. Born in 1975, he began learning the game as a child and joined the Guangdong provincial team in 1988.
biography.zh-CN: 许银川，1975年出生于广东惠来，中国象棋特级大师。自幼学习象棋，1988年进入广东省象棋队。

biography.en: Hu Ronghua, born in Shanghai in 1945, won fourteen Chinese national individual championships. His first title came in 1960 and his last in 2000. He also represented Shanghai in national team competitions.
biography.zh-CN: 胡荣华，1945年出生于上海，十四次获得全国象棋个人赛冠军，首次夺冠在1960年，最后一次在2000年。他也曾代表上海参加全国团体赛事。
